evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Tube pressure was 2.897 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.175 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints; the cause is unresolved.
Temperature 750.3 C and Ar 99.2 sccm closely track setpoints; controller reports running, but these readings do not verify atmosphere composition.

args.missing_evidence: A validated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth-pressure limits and a pressure/flow-path diagnostic would resolve the pressure trend. No sample characterization is available.
